notes: v1.14.532 — NAV CLEARANCE IS MEASURED (Ship B of RACK-DETAIL-CLEANUP). --rd-navclear was a hardcoded calc(96px + safe-bottom) while the real #rd-botnav footprint measures 122px at 390. Six rules read that token, so the stale value under-paid all of them; the visible symptom was the phase dock, anchored at bottom:108px under a 122px nav with its lowest 14px behind the nav. rd_syncNavClear now measures the nav and writes the token, re-running on a ResizeObserver over the nav box and on orientationchange. This is the second staleness of this kind — :1151 records --tabnav-h freezing at 72 while the nav grew to 96 — so the box writes the token rather than a constant describing the box. Redesign-only: legacy clears with --tabnav-h and never reads this token, and the function guards on redesign_isOn(), so ?legacy=1 is byte-identical.
